question:
Select the synonym of the given word.

vitiate
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vitiate"** means to spoil or impair the quality or efficiency of something; to make it faulty or defective. (बिगाड़ना)

 
 
• **Example: **The continuous interruptions during the meeting served to ***vitiate*** its effectiveness.
 
 
 
• **"Annihilate" **refers to completely destroying or obliterating something. (पूर्णतः नष्ट करना)
 
 
• **Example: **The hurricane managed to ***annihilate*** several coastal towns within hours.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'vitiate' **is **'annihilate'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Facilitate **(सुविधा प्रदान करना): To make an action or process easier.

 
 
• **Example:** The new software will ***facilitate** *the management of our inventory.
 
 
 
• **Validate **(मान्य करना ): To check or prove the validity or accuracy of something.
 
 
• **Example: **The results need to be ***validated*** before we can draw any conclusions.
 
 
 
• **Propagate** (प्रचार करना): To spread and promote an idea, theory, etc.
 
 
• **Example:** They used the media to ***propagate ***their political views.
